format_coverage: The real SY0-701 exam uses a maximum of 90 questions in 90 minutes and two item classes: multiple-choice (including select-two and select-three stems) and performance-based questions (PBQs). CompTIA publishes no count or weighting for PBQs. This mock supports three formats and approximates as follows. Multiple choice with one correct response maps exactly to single_choice, four options, as in every item of CompTIA's own free practice set. Select-two multiple choice maps exactly to multiple_response, all-or-nothing; select-three stems are supported by the same format if S3 widens select_count. Performance-based questions are NOT supported: a PBQ is an interactive simulation — building a firewall ruleset, dragging controls onto a topology, classifying log lines, completing a matrix — and Mockka has no simulation surface. PBQ reasoning is approximated two ways here, both of them demonstrated by CompTIA's own sample set: as scenario_matching where the task is genuinely a mapping (investigative questions onto log sources; situations onto agreement types), and as scenario-led single_choice over candidate configurations where the task has one defensible outcome — CompTIA's own sampler does exactly this with an access-list item whose four options are the same rule with source/destination and permit/deny transformed. The consequence, stated plainly: the underlying judgment is rehearsed, the interaction is not. You will meet the drag-and-drop and configuration-editor interfaces for the first time in the real exam, and the real paper's PBQs typically carry more marks per item than a multiple-choice question. Note also that the vendor states 'maximum of 90' questions, so a live form may be shorter than this mock.

provenance.nda_statement: This package contains no live exam content. Nothing here is drawn from the SY0-701 item bank, and no question reproduces an item encountered in a real sitting. Actual exam content is confidential and protected by the CompTIA Candidate Agreement; CompTIA's own Authorized Materials Use Policy states that candidates who prepare with unauthorised 'brain dump' material have their certifications revoked and are suspended from future testing. Sources whose items trace back to candidate recall of a live sitting were screened out at intake and are listed with evidence in derivation/sources.md. This is an independent study tool: it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to CompTIA, Inc. or Pearson VUE.
